author: agent
summary: Surfaced the causal matching decision without changing accepted content.
change_summary: Added one ambiguity and one proposal about weakening the accepted hypothesis.

ambiguities.question: Is endpoint matching enough to attribute later plasticity to replanning?
ambiguities.why_it_matters: The answer determines whether the current experiment isolates a mechanism or only compares two training histories.
candidates: The full update path must be matched

proposals.title: Narrow what the search result would establish

card.situation_cold: The accepted hypothesis says replanning restores future learning, but the current comparison does not yet match the learning path that produced the endpoint.
card.why_human_now: Weakening an accepted scientific claim changes the instruction sent to every control-panel agent.
card.consequences: The project would treat the current run as evidence about a combined training intervention, not replanning alone.
card.decision_needed: Decide whether to weaken the hypothesis before the matched-path run finishes.

changes.statement: Search-assisted training may preserve later learning, but the mechanism remains unidentified until update histories are matched.
